posts.title: She’s still got it
posts.description: This morning I found that my 17-year-old declawed, arthritic, blind cat who’s missing 9 teeth managed to catch and kill a mouse. I really don’t like that this is the second mouse we’ve had in the apartment in the span of a month (we’re leaving in a week) but she seemed like she was having the time of her life. posts.title: I want my world to be bigger
posts.description: I want my world to be bigger. Or maybe less that I want it to be ‘bigger’ but I want it to feel more real. I think I have had a trouble with the world feeling real since I was very little.
